description: Coco beach is located at the mouth of the Mandovi river opposite to the Panaji bank. The beach is home to a local fishing community who can regularly be seen hauling nets and boats along the beach especially in the mornings. Located close to the beach is the Reis Magos church and the Reis Magos fort. The beach is located at a distance of 5 kms. from Panaji and 14 kms. from Mapusa. A short distance away from the beach one can find many tour boats anchored in the bay at the mouth of the Nerul river. These are used by operators to take tourists on dolphin sighting tours. The tour route stretches from the bay right up to the base of Aguada fort and offers a great view of Aguada fort, Aguada prison and the lighthouse. Things to do -River Cruises -Fishing -Dolphin Sighting Tours -Visit Reis Magos fort. EXPLORING THE ALLURING COCO BEACH: YOUR TRAVEL GUIDE Embark on a delightful journey to Coco Beach in Goa with a variety of transportation options at your disposal, ensuring a seamless and enjoyable experience. 1. AUTO RICKSHAW: BUDGET-FRIENDLY RIDE Auto-rickshaws offer an economical and convenient mode of transportation to Coco Beach. Opt for auto rickshaws for a pocket-friendly alternative to taxis or cabs, whether you're arriving from the Goa International Airport or any train station. 2. BY AIR: AERIAL ESCAPE Travel by air to Coco Beach by booking flight tickets to Dabolim Airport, the sole airport in Goa. With a distance of approximately 36.3 kilometers from the airport, a car ride of around 1 hour will lead you to the captivating Coco Beach. 3. BY ROAD: COMFORTABLE COMMUTE Choose from a plethora of transportation services available in Goa to reach Coco Beach by road. State bus services connect major Indian cities like Mumbai, Delhi, and Pune. For added comfort, consider hiring a taxi or cab from the Goa International Airport to conveniently access Coco Beach. 4. BY RAIL: RAILS TO SHORE BLISS Plan your trip to Coco Beach by booking train tickets to major Goa train stations such as Vasco da Gama or Madgaon. A 50-minute drive from Madgaon train station covers the approximate 44-kilometer distance to Coco Beach. Alternatively, Vasco da Gama station is a mere 37.8 kilometers away. The nearest railway station to Coco Beach, Karmali, is approximately 23.1 kilometers from the beach. 5. FROM PANJIM (CAPITAL OF GOA): CLOSEST CONNECTION Coco Beach's proximity to Panjim, the capital of Goa, makes for a convenient journey. Covering a distance of only 10 kilometers, a half-hour drive from Panjim will lead you to Coco Beach. Opt for a taxi, auto-rickshaw, or the budget-friendly bus service for a hassle-free ride. With these diverse transportation options, your visit to the enchanting Coco Beach promises to be a memorable and accessible experience, ensuring relaxation and exploration in equal measure.
